_comment: Reconstructing the flash image out of a UF2 container. Every guard here is a silent-failure shape: drop one and the digest is still a plausible 32-bit number, just not the one the board reports. A wrong number that looks like an answer is worse than an error, so each guard has to be shown load-bearing.

mutations.name: payloadSize is read per block, not assumed to be 256
a block claiming more payload than a block holds is refused
a NOT_MAIN_FLASH block's bytes stay out of the image
a gap in the range is an error, not a hole filled with zeros
the container's magic values are checked
mutations.find: raise Uf2Error(f"block at byte {offset} has bad magic")

mutations.name: the trailing magic is one of the three checked
the first magic is one of the three checked
a file that is not a whole number of blocks is refused
mutations.find: if len(uf2) % UF2_BLOCK_SIZE != 0 or not uf2:

mutations.name: the digest covers exactly the reported length
the extent ignores blocks that are not main flash
mutations.find: if not flags & UF2_FLAG_NOT_MAIN_FLASH and payload_size

mutations.name: a container with no flash blocks has no extent to report
an unreadable artifact records no digest rather than a wrong one
